nodes.question: What percentage of the European Union's territory is covered by forests?
nodes.answer: Forests cover approximately 40% of the European Union's territory.
nodes.paragraph: Keywords Cultural theory Worldviews EU forest policy Governance Policy beliefs Forest ecosystem services * Jeanne-Lazya Roux jeanne.roux@wur.nl; Jeanne-lazya.roux@efi.int 1 European Forest Institute, Bonn, Germany 2 Forest and Nature Conservation Policy Group, Wageningen University and Research, Wageningen, The Netherlands 3 European Forest Institute, Joensuu, Finland 4 Institute of Forest, Environmental and Natural Resource Policy, Department of Economics and Social Sciences, University of Natural Resources and Life Sciences, BOKU, Vienna, Austria 5 Faculty of Environment and Natural Resources, Institute of Environmental Social Sciences, Chair of Forest and Environmental Policy, University of Freiburg, Freiburg, Germany Policy Sciences Introduction Forests cover approximately 40% of the European Union S (EU) territory, with large regional differences (Eurostat, 2020). Governing this vast share of the EU S land as part of the European policy integration process has been challenging (P Izl et al., 2018). European forests exhibit diverse biophysical and socioeconomic settings (Edwards et al., 2022; Winkel et al., 2022), and the EU S multi-level governance system involves numer - ous actors with varying values and interests (Lazdinis et al., 2019; Sotirov et al., 2021).
